```{python}
#| include: false
import altair as alt
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display

import nps.theme  # registers the napari-light/-dark themes from _brand.yml
from nps import data, plots

alt.renderers.set_embed_options(actions=False)


def show(chart):
    """Show ``chart`` once per theme; use in a cell with ``renderings: [light, dark]``."""
    for mode in ("light", "dark"):
        with alt.theme.enable(f"napari-{mode}"):
            display(chart)
```
